current_affairs.title: Mission Divyastra: Successful Flight-Test of Agni-5 with MIRV Technology
key_points: India successfully conducted the first flight test of the indigenously developed Agni-5 missile equipped with Multiple Independently Targetable Re-entry Vehicle (MIRV) technology.
MIRV capability allows a single missile to deploy multiple warheads at different targets hundreds of kilometers apart.
Developed by DRDO, placing India in an elite group of nations possessing MIRV capability (USA, Russia, China, France, UK).
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Strategic deterrence, indigenization of defense technology, ballistic missile systems.

current_affairs.title: India Adds 5 New Wetlands, Taking Total Ramsar Sites Count to 80
key_points: Five more Indian wetlands (three in Karnataka and two in Tamil Nadu) were designated as Ramsar sites of international importance.
New sites include Magadi Kere Conservation Reserve, Ankasamudra Bird Conservation Reserve, Aghanashini Estuary (Karnataka), and Karaivetti Bird Sanctuary, Longwood Shola Reserve Forest (Tamil Nadu).
India now ranks first in South Asia in the total number of Ramsar sites.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Ramsar Convention criteria, wetland ecosystem services, biodiversity conservation efforts.

current_affairs.title: Supreme Court Strikes Down Electoral Bonds Scheme
key_points: A Constitution Bench of the Supreme Court unanimously declared the Electoral Bonds Scheme unconstitutional.
The court held that anonymous political donations violate the voters' Right to Information under Article 19(1)(a) of the Constitution.
SBI was directed to stop issuing electoral bonds and disclose details of donors and recipient political parties to the Election Commission of India.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Fundamental Rights (Article 19), transparency in electoral funding, free and fair elections, judicial review.

current_affairs.title: RBI Guidelines on Climate-Related Financial Risks
key_points: The Reserve Bank of India released a draft disclosure framework on climate-related financial risks for Regulated Entities (REs).
Framework focuses on four thematic pillars: Governance, Strategy, Risk Management, and Metrics & Targets.
Aims to foster sustainable finance, improve climate resilience in the banking sector, and mitigate physical and transition risks.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Green banking, climate finance, financial sector stability, ESG disclosures.

current_affairs.title: Operationalization of the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC)
key_points: India and the UAE signed an Intergovernmental Framework Agreement to advance cooperation on the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC).
IMEC aims to connect India to Europe through the Gulf region via rail and shipping lines.
Envisaged as a counter to China's Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), fostering economic integration and supply chain resilience.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Geo-economics, strategic connectivity initiatives, West Asia policy, global supply chain resilience.
